title: Auralith: Sci-Fi Action RPG With Base Building and Much More
author: AuralithDev
selftext:
Hello! I'm working on a sci-fi action RPG called Auralith. I've been working on it for about 7 months now and am writing all the music/soundtrack and doing most of the foley/SFX myself at my home studio. I'm aiming to release a demo for free in January and should be done working on it in the next month or two. Here's a trailer I made recently and wrote the music for.

Does this look like something any of you would be interested in? I'm linking my discord if anyone wants to stay updated.

[https://discord.gg/PXSTEEK4G](https://discord.gg/PXSTEEK4G)
